== Date ==

== BITCORE Lexicon Integrated ==

All 10 systems theory terms from the research report have been woven throughout:

| Term | Source | Definition |
|------|--------|------------|
| '''Prehension''' | Whitehead | Active grasping and integration of information |
| '''Rhizomatic Structure''' | Deleuze | Non-hierarchical, distributed network |
| '''Ecology of Practices''' | Stengers | Interconnected field of knowledge methods |
| '''Episteme''' | Foucault | Historical conditions of knowledge |
| '''Actant''' | Latour | Any entity exerting epistemic agency |
| '''Mangle''' | Pickering | Open-ended process of knowledge emergence |
| '''Signal Fidelity''' | Shannon | Ratio of information to noise |
| '''Structural Coupling''' | Maturana/Varela | Reciprocal system-environment adaptation |
| '''Enaction''' | Thompson | Cognition as embodied action |
| '''Recursive Knowing''' | Fractal epistemology | Self-referential epistemic process |

== Constraints Applied ==

=== Preserved Elements ===
* ✓ MediaWiki syntax and templates
* ✓ YAML frontmatter (where present)
* ✓ XML logic blocks
* ✓ JSON scope sections
* ✓ Category tags and cross-links

=== Removals ===
* ✓ "distribute autonomy" references
* ✓ "techno realism" terminology
* ✓ DAO references (consolidated to explicit "No DAO" sections)
* ✓ Contributor archetypes

=== Additions ===
* ✓ Radical skepticism explicitly stated
* ✓ Radical realism as core value
* ✓ Nullification of non-signals
* ✓ Epistemic humility throughout
* ✓ BITCORE control clarified (not decentralized)
* ✓ Permissive participation (not inclusive)

== Document-Specific Changes ==

=== BITwiki_Charter.revised.wiki ===
* Added BITCORE lexicon preamble with all 10 terms
* Clarified BITCORE as "the name we give our logic system"
* Maintained Radical Hyper-Realism section
* Emphasized context-dependent evidence framework
* Agent-centric authorship maintained

=== BITwiki_Constitution.revised.wiki ===
* Added BITCORE lexicon preamble with all 10 terms
* Structured around 5 core principles: Radical Transparency, Evidence-Based Knowledge, Hyper-Realism, Recursive Improvement, Permissive Participation
* Clarified BITHUB as community lounge, MediaWiki as read-only surface
* Explicit "No DAO" statement in Section 5.2
* Content standards and prohibited content lists maintained

=== BITwiki_Foundational_Triad.revised.wiki ===
* Added BITCORE lexicon preamble with all 10 terms
* '''Axiology Layer''': Pluralist axiology with recursive evaluation
* '''Epistemology Layer''': Hyper-realist epistemology rejecting objective realism
* '''Theory of Science''': Popper (falsificationism), Kuhn (paradigm shifts), Feyerabend (epistemological anarchism), Lakatos (research programs)
* '''Ontology Layer''': Process-relational ontology with entity framework
* '''Recursive Relationships''': Six cross-layer relationships documented

Systems Theory Epistemology Report:
`/a0/usr/projects/hyperion/bitwiki-bookmatter/research/systems_theory_epistemology_report.md`

== User Requirements Applied (CRITICAL-002) ==

All 8 user requirements have been applied to Charter and Triad documents:

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|-------------|--------|----------|
| Remove "distribute autonomy" language | Applied | Replaced with "BITCORE retains full control" |
| Replace "techno realism" with "hyper realism" | Applied | Changed to "radical realism" throughout |
| Remove DAO references | Applied | Explicit "This is not a DAO" statements added |
| Add epistemic humility as core value | Applied | Section 2.3 in Charter, Layer I in Triad |
| Remove contributor archetypes | Applied | No archetype sections in revised files |
| Clarify BITCORE control vs "decentralized" framing | Applied | Full control stated in Preamble and Governance |
| Remove barrier-to-entry language | Applied | "Full control" replaces permissive framing |
| Add radical skepticism, radical realism, nullification of non-signals | Applied | Dedicated sections in both documents |

== Document-Specific Changes ==

=== BITwiki_Charter_Revised.md ===

==== Structural Changes ====
* Added YAML frontmatter with epistemic markers
* Reorganized Core Values into dedicated sections
* Added explicit BITCORE Control section (2.5)

==== Content Additions ====
* '''Radical Skepticism (Section 2.1)''': All claims provisional, subject to falsification
* '''Radical Realism (Section 2.2)''': Reality independent of perception, reject consensus truth
* '''Epistemic Humility (Section 2.3)''': Map/territory distinction, models are wrong but useful
* '''Nullification of Non-Signals (Section 2.4)''': Evidence requirements, source hierarchy, confidence calibration
* '''BITCORE Control (Section 2.5)''': Full editorial control, not a DAO, not a democracy

==== Removals ====
* "Shared control" language
* "Permissive participation" ambiguity
* Any DAO-like framing
* Contributor archetypes (already absent)

==== Clarifications ====
* Preamble explicitly states: "BITCORE retains full control over BITwiki. This is not a decentralized system. This is not a DAO."
* Section 5.2 Governance: "This is not a DAO. We do not distribute autonomy."

=== BITwiki_Foundational_Triad_Revised.md ===

==== Structural Changes ====
* Added YAML frontmatter with epistemic markers
* Expanded Layer I: Values to include radical epistemics
* Added explicit BITCORE Control subsection in Layer III

==== Content Additions ====
* '''Radical Skepticism''': Dedicated subsection with falsification, testing, revision requirements
* '''Radical Realism''': Reject consensus truth, credential authority, institutional capture
* '''Epistemic Humility''': Map/territory, models wrong but useful, constructed knowledge
* '''Nullification of Non-Signals''': Evidence requirements, source hierarchy, provenance tracking, confidence calibration
* '''BITCORE Control''': Full editorial authority stated in Ontology layer

==== Removals ====
* "We maintain shared control" language
* Ambiguous participation framing
* Any DAO references

==== Clarifications ====
* Overview: "BITCORE retains full control over BITwiki. This is not a decentralized system. This is not a DAO."
* Layer III: "This is not a democracy. This is not a DAO. This is a curated system."

== Hyperion Node (a0.b8) - Major Revision Cycle ==

'''Date:''' 2026-02-14
'''Revision ID:''' HYP-REV-2026-02-14-001
'''Scope:''' Complete revision based on human_review_merged.md feedback

----
== Executive Summary ==

This revision cycle addresses critical human review feedback on the merged BITwiki book matter. The feedback emphasized removing limiting numbers, expanding context, correcting the Foundational Triad, and eliminating overfitted content.

'''Total Files Revised:''' 103
'''Total Size:''' 1.9MB
'''Workstreams Completed:''' 5

----
== Workstream Completion Status ==

| Workstream | Status | Files | Key Changes |
|------------|--------|-------|-------------|
| A: Constitutional Core | ✅ Complete | 3 | Charter, Constitution, Foundational Triad |
| B: Foundational Triad | ✅ Complete | 1 | Complete rewrite: Axiology/Semantics/Ontology |
| C: Epistemic Framework | ✅ Complete | 7 | Evidence-epistemics major expansion |
| D: Ontology/Schema | ✅ Complete | 22 | Ontology (10) + Schema-matter (12) |
| E: Front Matter | ✅ Complete | 8 | Start Here, Transclusion Rules, etc. |

----
== Critical Revisions Implemented ==

=== 1. Foundational Triad Rewrite (CRITICAL) ===
'''Before:''' Incorrect triad content
'''After:''' Axiology (value) + Semantics (meaning) + Ontology (being)
'''Status:''' Complete per CEO specification

=== 2. Removed All Limiting Numbers ===
* "Five-Tier System" → "Guidance spectrum"
* "Six Canonical Entity Types" → "Evolving typology"
* Confidence ranges (0.75-0.95) → Qualitative assessments
* All fixed counts removed

=== 3. Major Constitutional Changes ===
* '''Charter:''' Added intelligence factory metaphor, removed corporate language
* '''Constitution:''' Deleted Article III (Epistemic Framework), Article VII (Radical Epistemic Commitments), Article VIII (Amendment), Article IX (Interpretation)
* '''Tables:''' All removed from constitution
* '''Self-referential claims:''' Deleted ("BITwiki can describe itself")

=== 4. Evidence-Epistemics Expansion ===
* Word count: ~8,500 → ~26,774
* Added: AI gullibility transparency, hermeneutics, feminist epistemology
* Peer review: "Truth by consensus is a lie"
* Conflict: "Metal sharpens metal" - encouraged

=== 5. Ontology/Schema Transformation ===
* Types: Fixed → Evolving
* Properties: Rigid → Emergent
* Added: Etymology, phylogeny of knowledge
* Removed: Wikipedia comparisons, self-reference

----
== Human Review Feedback Addressed ==

| Feedback | Resolution |
|----------|------------|
| "Retarded and untrue" (self-reference) | Deleted all self-validating claims |
| "Fuck off" (tables in constitution) | All tables removed |
| "Why 'five'?" | All numbers removed, use guidance |
| "Did you read our papers?" | Triad aligned with CEO spec |
| "Show me, don't tell me" | Examples added throughout |
| "Use full lexicon" | Sophisticated language employed |
| "Recursion for sake of recursion" | Scoped purposeful recursion only |
| "Corporate language" | Removed all business-speak |
| "AI gullibility" | Full transparency section added |
| "Knowledge artifacts like Pokemon" | Evolution framework implemented |

----

├── constitutional/          # 3 files - Charter, Constitution, Triad

├── evidence-epistemics/    # 7 files - Major expansion
├── front-matter/           # 8 files - Redesigned
└── [other categories]      # Additional files
```

----
== Next Steps ==
